# Skribly

Skribly is a local-first contextual notes application for Windows 10 and Windows 11.

## Core product

- Notes attach to an open application window.
- Finished notes collapse into small movable dots instead of permanently covering the screen.
- Clicking a dot opens a compact preview or a larger focused editor.
- The editor supports typed text, drawing, images and small local file attachments.
- Saved Skribs lists notes and can reconnect a note to a matching open application.
- The global shortcut is Ctrl + Shift + Space.
- The current beta does not require an account or cloud sync for normal note use.

## Difference from ordinary sticky notes

Ordinary sticky notes mainly preserve text in standalone note windows. Skribly is designed around spatial and application context: the note follows the application, retains a relative position, collapses into a compact anchor, and can help the user return to the matching app.

## Availability

- Platform: Windows beta
- Supported operating systems: Windows 10 and Windows 11, x64
- macOS: not yet available
- Website: https://skribly-desktop.vercel.app/
- Download endpoint: https://skribly-desktop.vercel.app/api/download
- Release notes: https://skribly-desktop.vercel.app/release-notes
- Privacy policy: https://skribly-desktop.vercel.app/privacy

## Pricing plan

The planned commercial model is:

- seven-day full trial with no card;
- ₹999 one-time personal launch licence;
- permanent use of the purchased version;
- twelve months of updates included;
- optional update pass after the included update period;
- no forced monthly subscription.

The current beta remains free until licence activation and paid checkout are validated end to end.

## Privacy

The Windows beta stores note data and attachments locally. The public website currently uses no advertising cookies and no behavioural analytics. Paid checkout is not active yet.

## Known limitations

- unsigned beta installer;
- mixed-DPI multi-monitor behaviour remains experimental;
- no browser DOM anchoring;
- no cloud sync;
- no macOS build;
- licence activation is not yet enabled.
